2215-01-101-0004
Urban Water Supply
Schemes
(Establishment and
Committed
Expenditure)
column7:
Augmentation in
provision of ₹90.00
lakh was the net effect
of increase of
125.00 lakh and
decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹35.00 lakh. Increase
was attributed to need
of additional amount
in salary, subsistence
allowance, house rent
allowance, transport
allowance and medical
allowance. Decrease
was attributed to
anticipated saving.
Reasons for final
saving have not been
intimated (July 2024).
